title: Thomas Biskup - Experiences from crowdfunding ADOM
speaker: Thomas Biskup
description:
Thomas Biskup talks about his experiences crowdfunding ADOMs, lessons learned, best practices and things to know before you do something potentially foolish.
This video is from the 2017 Roguelike Celebration: https://roguelike.club/event2017.html
